detailsSection:
With the latest updates, SCOM 2019/2022 have been enhanced to support the monitoring of Linux distributions configured with crypto-policies enabled in FIPS (Federal Information Processing Standards) mode. This capability ensures that organizations adhering to strict cryptographic standards can seamlessly monitor their Linux workloads within a FIPS-compliant environment.
It's essential to apply this hotfix in addition to updating Linux/Unix MPs.

The Linux Operating Systems Management Packs enable discovering, monitoring, and managing Linux computers with System Center Operations Manager 2022. They provide both proactive and reactive monitoring of the Linux operating systems. The management packs monitor components such as processes, resources, and server agents. The monitoring provided by the management packs includes availability and configuration monitoring, performance data collection, and default thresholds. You can integrate the monitoring of Linux components into your service-oriented monitoring scenarios. In addition to health monitoring capabilities, the management packs include reports, diagnostics, tasks, and views that enable near real-time diagnosis and resolution of detected issues. The management packs also enable the installation of the Audit Collection Services for Linux Management Packs.

Feature Summary: System Center 2022 Management Pack for Linux Operating Systems
  • Provides monitoring of the Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7, 8, 9, and 10 operating systems.
  • Provides monitoring of SUSE Linux Enterprise Server 12 and 15 operating systems.
  • Provides monitoring of OpenSUSE Linux Leap 15 operating systems.
  • Provides monitoring of Debian GNU/Linux 9, 10, 11, 12, and 13 operating systems.
  • Provides monitoring of Oracle Linux 7, 8, 9, and 10 operating systems.
  • Provides monitoring of Rocky Linux 8, 9, and 10 operating systems.
  • Provides monitoring of Alma Linux 8, 9, and 10 operating systems.
  • Provides monitoring of Ubuntu Linux Server 18.04, 20.04, 22.04, 24.04, and 26.04 operating systems.
  • Enables the installation of the Audit Collection Services for UNIX/Linux Management Packs.

systemRequirementsSection:

Monitoring of the following operating systems is supported:
  • RHEL 7, 8, 9, 10
  • SLES 12, 15
  • Ubuntu 18.04, 20.04, 22.04, 24.04, 26.04
  • Debian 9, 10, 11, 12, 13
  • Oracle Linux 7, 8, 9, 10
  • Rocky Linux 8, 9, 10
  • Alma Linux 8, 9, 10
  • OpenSUSE Leap 15
installInstructionSection:
1. Download and install System Center Operations Manager 2022.
2. Download and install the updated management packs.
3. Import the management packs for the monitored Linux server types.
4. Use the Operations Console to upgrade the Linux agents in the Administration\UNIX/Linux computers view.
